A module whose docs have what Markdown misreads: placeholders such as <name> in prose, in a code span, in a double backtick span and in an autolink, an example indented by two spaces, a list whose items run on to indented lines, a fence the author wrote, and an args section. The page must put each placeholder in a code span and each indented example in a fenced code block, and keep the code spans, the fence and the list's lines as written. Rendered with a source URL, the page's front matter must carry the edit link to the module's source under it; the index must carry the placeholders of the summary in code spans.
